title: Amazon (AWS) signs second Cipher lease, 70 MW at Stingray (~$2B)

sources.quote: Cipher Digital has executed a second data center lease with Amazon Data Services, Inc.

explain: Amazon's data center arm signed a second, 15-year lease with Cipher (renamed Cipher Digital) for 70 megawatts at its Stingray site in Andrews, Texas, with rent from 2027. Cipher's investor presentation puts contracted revenue at about $2.0 billion; the lease was signed in early 2026 and first named as Amazon in June. The ~$2.0 billion figure is Cipher's own estimate of contracted revenue from its investor presentation, so it is shown as an estimate.
